그 달 승선 중인 선원의 국적을 기준으로 필요한 통화를 자동으로 보여줍니: Automatically shows the currencies needed based on the nationalities of crew onboard that month (KRW is always included). Enter rates once a month and they'll be applied automatically when creating management fee invoices.
이 달에 값을 입력하지 않은 통화는 청구서 작성 시 가장 최근에 입력된: If a currency has no rate entered for this month, invoices will use the most recently entered rate from a previous month instead. If none exists at all, that item will not be converted and will be shown as a warning.
